import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define constants and types
N = 100  # Example size of the vector
alpha = 0.1  # Example filter parameter
K = 5  # Example Gaussian filter workspace size

# Define GSL functions and types
class GSLVector(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class GSLRng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class GSLFilterGaussianWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Set up GSL function prototypes
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)
gsl.gsl_rng_mt19937 = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_mt19937")
gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterGaussianWorkspace)
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)
gsl.gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterGaussianWorkspace)]
gsl.gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)]
gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)]
gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterGaussianWorkspace)]

# Allocate resources
try:
    r = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_mt19937)
    if not r:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate RNG.")
    gauss_p = gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian_alloc(K)
    if not gauss_p:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate Gaussian filter workspace.")
    x = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    y = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    dy = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    d2y = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    if not x or not y or not dy or not d2y:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate vectors.")

    # Populate input vector
    for i in range(N):
        xi = 0.5 if i > N / 2 else 0.0
        ei = np.random.normal(0, 0.1)  # Gaussian noise
        gsl.gsl_vector_set(x, i, xi + ei)

    # Apply Gaussian filtering
    gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian(0, alpha, 0, x, y, gauss_p)
    gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian(0, alpha, 1, x, dy, gauss_p)
    gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian(0, alpha, 2, x, d2y, gauss_p)

    # Print results
    for i in range(N):
        xi = gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i)
        yi = gsl.gsl_vector_get(y, i)
        dyi = gsl.gsl_vector_get(dy, i)
        d2yi = gsl.gsl_vector_get(d2y, i)
        if i == 0:
            dxi = gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i + 1) - xi
        elif i == N - 1:
            dxi = xi - gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i - 1)
        else:
            dxi = 0.5 * (gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i + 1) - gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i - 1))
        print(f"{xi:.12e} {yi:.12e} {dxi:.12e} {dyi:.12e} {d2yi:.12e}")

    # Free resources
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(x)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(y)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(dy)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(d2y)
    gsl.gsl_rng_free(r)
    gsl.gsl_filter_gaussian_free(gauss_p)

except MemoryError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")


def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Validate output format
    try:
        assert N > 0, "Vector size must be positive."
        assert alpha > 0, "Alpha must be positive."
        print("Test case 1 passed.")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test case 1 failed: {e}")

    # Test case 2: Validate memory allocation
    try:
        assert r, "RNG allocation failed."
        assert gauss_p, "Gaussian filter workspace allocation failed."
        assert x and y and dy and d2y, "Vector allocation failed."
        print("Test case 2 passed.")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test case 2 failed: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
